title: Spread the Load
briefing: Kestrel Air, Harborline Shipping and Orchard Foods. Two of these have something important in common. Spread your money wisely.
objective: Diversify across companies with different drivers. Correlated holdings act like one big bet.
debrief: All three stocks rose until day 14, when a refinery fire sent fuel prices soaring. Kestrel Air and Harborline Shipping both burn huge amounts of fuel, so both gapped down together; Orchard Foods barely noticed. Holding the airline and the shipper was one fuel bet, not two. Players who capped each position and paired one fuel-sensitive stock with Orchard Foods kept the damage small.

news.headline: Fuel prices jump 25% after a refinery fire
news.body: A fire at the region's largest refinery has pushed fuel prices up by a quarter. Airlines and shipping companies are expected to be hit hardest.

basic.text: Hold at least 2 different companies at the same time
Keep every position at or under 40% of your portfolio
